selection: All STEAD splits; M>=3 and P offset>=10 s; all selected P labels equal 10 s
input_waveforms: Same raw ZNE counts at 100 Hz; each record contains 60 s; no synthetic prefill

runtime.normalization: per-channel causal EWMA demean and scale

eqtransformer_original.confirmation_use: Unchanged public weights and public operating points fixed before any V21 2023 output.

operating_points.threshold_source: SeisBench public P default; not tuned on V17
Public P and detection defaults, with detection support required at the P-episode peak; not tuned on V17

trailing_window_filter.application: Applied inside each fully historical native window; no samples after that window end are read.

phasenet_instance.confirmation_use: Unchanged public weights and public operating points fixed before any V21 2023 output.

operating_points.threshold_source: INSTANCE weight-specific public default selected for in-domain F1; not tuned on V17

matching: One TP per event record within +/-1.5 s; all additional candidate episodes count as FP
public_endpoint: P-only; released half-threshold hysteresis, episode closure, blinding, native stride and first publication semantics
publication_clock: 0.5 s packet clock; window-based model predictions are available only after their complete native window arrives; wall-clock compute time excluded
normalization: CSPP retains packet EWMA; public models retain their released native-window preprocessing; EQTransformer 1-45 Hz zero-phase filter is restricted to the fully received 60 s window
scan_role: Exploratory evaluation-cohort scan, not an untouched test or a deployment-threshold update
threshold_selection: Highest F1, then recall, then precision, then higher thresholds; report all-record selection separately from dev-selected points on the original 600 test records
limitations: No noise-only windows: candidate precision is conditional on event windows
No matched retraining; released checkpoints have different training sources
STEAD is a training source for original EQTransformer; full-cohort results include original train/dev splits
Original test split is record-level; event/station overlap has not been audited
P is fixed at the 10 s packet boundary; this is not arbitrary-onset continuous replay
Window fill delay depends on cold start and native-window policy, not only neural inference speed
Source magnitude and P labels are used only to define and score the cohort
